newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends mixed on late trade sell-off.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mixed on late trade sell-off.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended mixed after easing in late trading on trade selling and profit-taking. Players are waiting for the outcome of Egyptian tender. Lack of other tenders and leads also limited price movements. Trading was volatile.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market saw some refiners buying. Interest seen among nearby CPOs and selected products.
At the close, third month February futures contract eased one ringgit to 1,225 ringgit ($484.96) a tonne after trading between 1,223 and 1,236 ringgit.

Traders said the contract next support level is 1,220 ringgit and resistance at 1,240. Some traders were optimistic that the downside potential will be limited as the underlying fundamentals sentiment was good.

Production is November was estimated to have fallen by 10 to 15 percent from October. "Stocks are still projecting at below one million tonnes. Some people estimated end-November stocks at around 980,000 tonnes because of better exports," one said.
Trading was active and turnover was 2,178 lots from 1,824 on Tuesday
Among physical sector, November (south) was offered at 1,222.50 ringgit a tonne with bids at 1,215 after trading at 1,225.
December (south) saw offers at 1,235 ringgit and bids at 1,230 and earlier trades were 1,230 to 1,240, and Dec (central) was at 1,225 against 1,215.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $522.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/March at $520. Dec was traded at $520.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $565 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $555. Dec was traded at $562.50.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $377.50 and Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5250 ringgit)
